```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(showtext)
# Fuente para los graficos. Se busca en las rutas habituales del sistema en vez
# de una ruta fija; PRUEBASUDD_FONT_REGULAR permite apuntar a otro archivo.
# Si no se encuentra, se usa la fuente por defecto en lugar de fallar el render.
setup_report_font <- function(family = "Libertinus Sans",
                              filename = "LibertinusSans-Regular.otf") {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("PRUEBASUDD_FONT_REGULAR"),
    file.path(sysfonts::font_paths(), filename),
    file.path(path.expand("~/Library/Fonts"), filename),
    file.path("/Library/Fonts", filename),
    file.path("/usr/share/fonts/opentype/libertinus", filename),
    file.path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/libertinus", filename)
  )
  candidates <- candidates[nzchar(candidates) & file.exists(candidates)]

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    message("Fuente '", family, "' no encontrada; se usa la fuente por defecto.")
    return("sans")
  }

  font_add(family = family, regular = candidates[1])
  showtext_auto()
  family
}

base_font <- setup_report_font()

# Set locale to UTF-8
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "es_MX.UTF-8")

fix_gt_latex_accents <- function(gt_tbl) {
  x <- as.character(gt::as_latex(gt_tbl))
  
  # Corrige \\' por \'
  x <- gsub(
    "\\\\\\\\'([A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÚáéíóúÑñÜü])",
    "\\\\'\\1",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  # Corrige diéresis si se escaparon como \" (por seguridad)
  x <- gsub(
    "\\\\\\\\\"([A-Za-zÜü])",
    "\\\\\"\\1",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  # Devuelve el string limpio listo para cat()
  x
}

#metadata <- list(results = res_joined, students = students, results_general = results_general, ejes = ejes, questions_extra= forma_10, sessions = sessions)

md <- readRDS(params$data_file)
param_session_id <- params$session_id
sid <- params$student_id

student_results <- md$results %>%
  filter(student_id == sid) 

student <- md$students %>%
  filter(student_id == sid) %>%
  slice(1)

ejes <- md$ejes

results_general <- md$results_general
student_summary <- results_general %>%
   filter(student_id == sid) %>%
  slice(1)

# Get session info
session <- md$sessions %>%
  filter(session_id == param_session_id) %>%
  slice(1)

# Extract questions that were answered incorrectly
incorrectas <- student_results %>%
  filter(!is_correcta) %>%
  arrange(Pregunta)

# Results for all students in the session (already filtered by Revisador_modern.R)
# No need to extract from session - results_general already contains only session students
resultados_seccion <- results_general %>%
  arrange(desc(porcentaje))

forma_10 <- md$questions_extra

```

## Resumen General

**Alumno:** `r student$name`  
**ID:** `r sid`  
**Puntaje:** `r student_summary$correctas`/`r student_summary$n`  
**Resultado:** \qty[drop-zero-decimal]{`r sprintf('%.1f', student_summary$porcentaje)`}{\percent} de logro en la evaluación.


## Desempeño por eje
```{r eje_summary, results='asis'}
#student_results
eje_summary <- student_results %>%
 group_by(Eje) %>%
 summarise(correctas = sum(is_correcta), total = n(), porcentaje = 100*correctas/total, .groups = "drop") %>%
 arrange(Eje) %>%
 mutate(
 Categoria = case_when(
   porcentaje < 50 ~ "Bajo",
   porcentaje <= 75 ~ "Mejorable",
   TRUE ~ "Bueno"
 )
)
eje_summary <- eje_summary %>%
 left_join(ejes, by = c("Eje" = "identificador"))
lowest_two <- eje_summary %>% arrange(porcentaje) %>% slice_head(n=2) %>% pull(nombre)
lowest_eje <- lowest_two[1]
second_lowest_eje <- lowest_two[2]

eje_gt <- eje_summary %>%
 select(Unidad = nombre, `Porcentaje (%)` = porcentaje, Categoria) %>%
 gt() %>%
 fmt_number(columns = `Porcentaje (%)`, decimals = 1)
cat(fix_gt_latex_accents(eje_gt))
```

Tus dos ejes con menor desempeño fueron **`r lowest_eje`** y **`r second_lowest_eje`**.

```{r ejes-grafico}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 1.5
ggplot(eje_summary, aes(x=reorder(nombre, porcentaje), y=porcentaje, fill=Categoria)) +
 geom_col(width = 0.5) +
 coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dotted", color = "dimgray") +
 scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), breaks=seq(0,100,10)) +
 scale_fill_manual(
   values = c("Bajo" = "lightsalmon", "Mejorable" = "dodgerblue", "Bueno" = "springgreen3"),
   drop = FALSE
 ) +
 labs(y="Porcentaje (%)") +
 theme_minimal(base_family = base_font) +
 theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())+
  theme(text = element_text(family = base_font)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=7))+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=10))
```

```{r, fig.height=1.18, fig.width=6}
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )
```

## Preguntas incorrectas

```{r build_incorrectas, include=FALSE}
latex_incorrectas <- NULL
if (nrow(incorrectas) > 0) {

  # Simplified function - data is already properly formatted
  fix_macros <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return("")
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    
    # Only handle potential data quality issues
    # Collapse multiple spaces
    x <- gsub("[ ]{2,}", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
    
    return(x)
  }

  latex_incorrectas <- paste(capture.output({
    cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(incorrectas))) {
      # Enunciado
      txt <- incorrectas$Texto[i]; if (is.na(txt)) txt <- ""
      txt <- fix_macros(txt)
      cat("\\item \\begin{minipage}[t]{\\linewidth}", txt, "\n", sep = "")

      # ----- leer alternativas desde la list-column -----
      alts <- incorrectas$Alternativas[[i]]
      if (is.null(alts)) alts <- character(0)
      alts <- fix_macros(alts)
      alts <- alts[!is.na(alts) & nzchar(alts)]

      cat("    \\begin{enumerate}[label=\\alph*)]\n")
      if (length(alts)) {
        for (a in alts) cat("    \\item ", a, "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("    \\end{enumerate}\n\\end{minipage}")
      if (i < nrow(incorrectas)) cat("\n")
    }
    cat("\n\\end{itemize}\n")
  }), collapse = "\n")

} else {
  latex_incorrectas <- "Todas correctas."
}
```

```{r print_incorrectas, results='asis'}
cat(latex_incorrectas)
```
